written.headline: Anthropic compute costs rise to 58% of revenue in Q3, widening operating loss
written.summary: Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $17 billion, up from $11.5 billion in the prior quarter. Compute spending rose to $10 billion, or 58% of revenue, widening its operating loss.

written.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million
written.summary: CrowdStrike announced agreements to buy AI‑agent observability firm Fiddler AI and AI‑security testing startup Dreadnode, in deals reported at roughly $400 million and $95 million respectively, paid mostly in cash. The acquisitions will be integrated into CrowdStrike’s Falcon platform as Falcon Observe and expanded testing capabilities.

written.headline: Simon Willison shows Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights
written.summary: Simon Willison reported that the Qwen 3.8 27B model running on his laptop was able to read and reason about raw neural network weights. The experiment took about 45 minutes and reproduced results described in the paper on Weight‑Space Programming.
